$comment: Which reference to read for a change (plan WP4). paths_any: globs on changed files; anchors_any: regexes on added or removed lines; always: every change; on_demand: the task decides, the diff cannot. Render the SKILL.md table with node tools/bin/render-routes.ts.

routes.when: You add or change a PHP MCP tool class, its DI service tag, tool group, annotations, dry-run behavior, or DAL criteria handling.
An app declares MCP capabilities in Resources/mcp.xml or app scripts, or you add an MCP resource, resource template, or prompt.
You write tests for MCP tools or debug capability discovery and registration.
